title: Where To Get Help & Support
content:
## Where To Get Help & Support


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000649874

We all need support at one time or another, and the great news is we have LOTS of ways to get the support  needed! Below are easy ways to get support.

Help Center Articles Our knowledge base is filled with great documentation about how the directory software works inside and out! Find questions to common questions as well as advanced documentation for developers Go To Knowledge Center » Customizations & Advanced Changes Have neat ideas to customize the site? Get free quotes from certified developers at fair prices in the Marketplace. From small changes to total theme makeovers, get the help needed here! Go To Marketplace » Book Private Phone Training Become a directory master by taking advantage of training sessions. Learn how to manage the directory and increase productivity. View Training Topics » Contact Technical Support Can't find what you are looking for in either of the places above, contact our team directly. We're happy to help! Submit A Ticket » (Fastest Response) Or Email support@brilliantdirectories.com » (Takes Longer To Process)
